topic_word_translation: spicy beef noodle soup from Hue

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Vietnamese people say phở is the best dish, but I think bún bò Huế is truly the king of soups. It's spicier and much more flavorful.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Interesting! You don't seem like the Mira I know. The Mira I'm familiar with usually prefers phở because it's light and elegant.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't be silly! Of course I'm Mira. I just tried bún bò Huế at a place near the chess club and discovered it's incredibly ngon. Phở is too mainstream now.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Alright, I believe you. But I'm surprised to hear you say that. Maybe we should go eat bún bò Huế together this weekend so I can see what excites you so much?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I... I didn't say I wanted to go with you! But if you want to know why bún bò Huế is better than phở, I could show you that place.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: So, are we meeting Sunday at 7pm? I'm curious whether it's the best bún bò Huế in Saigon, or if you're just influenced by the atmosphere of the place?
